description: Minecraft server-side mod that adds session timer for defined player list and kicks them after elapsed timer.

mods.name: Playtime Limiter
mods.description: A lightweight server-side Fabric mod designed to control and restrict player session times, tracking user activity via UUIDs and automatically disconnecting players when their time expires.

releases.notes:
## Installation

> **Note:** This mod is built specifically for **Minecraft 1.21.1** using Fabric Loader.

1. Make sure you have **Fabric Loader** (compatible with Minecraft 1.21.1) installed on your server.
2. Download the `.jar` file of the `PlaytimeLimiter` mod for version 1.21.1.
3. Drop it into the `mods` folder of your Fabric server.
4. Start the server. The configuration file will be automatically generated at `config/playtimelimiter/timers.json`.
